title: Rhodes Scholarship for West Africa
eligibleFor: Eligible applicants connected to a listed West African country, including Ghana, who meet the Rhodes age, academic, and residency criteria.
description: A fully funded postgraduate scholarship for study at the University of Oxford. Applicants should use the West Africa constituency guidance to confirm their route and course eligibility.

title: Breakthrough Junior Challenge
eligibleFor: Students worldwide aged 13–18 who meet the competition's published age dates and submission requirements.
description: A global science communication competition inviting students to explain a challenging scientific or mathematical concept through a short original video.

title: WIPO Young Experts Program
eligibleFor: Early-career professionals aged 35 or younger with a university degree, at least two years of relevant experience, and an interest in innovation or intellectual property.
description: A two-year professional development programme at WIPO in Geneva combining on-the-job learning with exposure to the international intellectual property system.

title: Africa Prize for Engineering Innovation
eligibleFor: Individuals or small teams based in sub-Saharan Africa who are developing an engineering-led innovation and meet the current cycle rules.
description: A Royal Academy of Engineering programme offering shortlisted innovators commercialisation training, mentoring, and the opportunity to compete for financial awards.

title: KAUST Visiting Student Research Program
eligibleFor: Third- or fourth-year bachelor's students and master's students in STEM who meet the requirements of a listed research project.
description: A project-based research programme where visiting students work with KAUST faculty on scientific and engineering research for approximately two to six months.
sourceName: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

title: UNICEF Internship Programme
eligibleFor: Students enrolled in undergraduate, graduate, or doctoral study, and graduates within the past two years, subject to each vacancy's requirements.
description: UNICEF advertises paid internship vacancies across multiple offices and professional areas throughout the year. Location, eligibility, and closing dates vary by assignment.

title: AIMS AI for Science Master's Scholarship
eligibleFor: Students from across Africa with an eligible quantitative undergraduate qualification and a strong interest in AI-enabled scientific research.
field: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & Mathematical Sciences
description: A fully supported master's programme at AIMS South Africa focused on applying artificial intelligence and mathematical methods to scientific challenges.

title: African Union Digital & Innovation Fellowship
eligibleFor: Citizens of African Union Member States under 35 with a degree in a relevant technical field, subject to the current cohort requirements.
description: A 12-month fellowship that places selected technical professionals within African Union institutions to support practical digital transformation projects.

title: Yale Young African Scholars
eligibleFor: African citizens, permanent residents, or refugees aged 14–18 who attend secondary school in Africa and meet the programme's grade-level rules.
description: A tuition-free academic enrichment programme offering online college preparation and a residential leadership summit for eligible African secondary school students.
